note: Hard B, lineage reading: base.json names v1 as this recipe's mother, so the declared difference is against v1 -- the same element list and the same wiring, with the three new variables expressed as parameters (command window, action joint groups, guarded contact termination). params_version is filtered as identity: it says which recipe this is, and it is what makes the two recipes different at all.

baseline_fixed_command.why: v2's first variable: the command window opens from the fixed point 0.5 to 1.0-3.0 m/s, sampled by the framework's own 10 s resampling window. lin_vel_y and ang_vel_z stay at zero, and both rewrite switches stay off, so the added variable is speed and nothing else

wiring.why: v2's second variable lives in this recipe's own document rather than in a new element: the shared wiring reads `action.joints`, and this document leaves the blade joints out, so the group drives haa/hfe/kfe (22 dims instead of 26). The joints keep their PD and their actuator group -- this removes the shortcut, not the degree of freedom: v1's trained checkpoint shuffled the blades while one hind foot stayed at 0.002 duty

baseline_base_contact.why: v2's third variable: the head chain may not touch the ground. The element builds this dwell term only where the yaml declares `contact_load_guard`, so v1 resolves without it -- a chest or neck vertical reaction above 1 N ends the episode on the frame it happens (dwell 0). Flat ground gives the head nothing to step over, and the 1 N is the same 'in contact' threshold `base_contact` uses. An earlier draft's 10%-of-body-weight-sustained-0.5 s reading is defeated by contact chatter: the rollout it was written for pressed 87.2 N on two thirds of its frames but never held it 0.5 s, so v1's failure pose would have trained straight through it

allowed.experiment_name: one version, one log directory (versioning.mdc A): v2 states lizard_baseline_v2 so a run cannot land in v1's directory
allowed.max_iterations: declared as intended (10000) rather than left at v1's 3000 that its run overrode by CLI to 15000 -- the recorded run has to be reproducible from its own NOTES
